name: Sphinx ladies’ tresses
desc: Sphinx ladies’ tresses (Spiranthes incurva): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Spiranthes incurva, the Sphinx ladies' tresses, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This orchid is native to the upper Midwest and Great Lakes Basin of North America.
